Meet Yoto 4th Generation. 🟢
Three years in the making, our 4th Gen players have been rebuilt from the inside out. It’s the same Yoto magic… only better.

🟢 A brand-new green button: a brilliantly simple shortcut to the audio your family love most, without always needing a Yoto Card 
🔊 Upgraded hardware for faster downloads and even bigger memory for ever-growing libraries
🌙 A customisable full-panel night light on Yoto Player for even better bedtimes 
💪Now IP67 rated and built for the rough and tumble of real childhood, Yoto Mini is ready for highchair tumbles, puddle splashes and every adventure in between.

And let’s face it… they look pretty great too!
Pre-order now for estimated dispatch from 30th Sept for Yoto Mini & from 15th Oct for Yoto Player via the link in bio
